claim: 单次云端调用成本公式：Cost_per_call = (L_in * P_in + L_out * P_out) / 1e6，其中 P_in=$2.50, P_out=$10.00，代入 L_in=12000, L_out=500 得 Cost_per_call = (12000*2.5 + 500*10)/1e6 = $0.035
